parent_hardening_notes: The proof admits all of ~/.local, which holds ~/.local/state/omp-seats, the seat checkouts and state roots that seats may write (hcom-seat:1373 lists the seat directory and its state directory as write roots). No current caller writes there (the four destinations are ~/.agents/compactiondb, ~/.agents/skills/security-audit, ~/.local/lib/omp-extensions/pi-claude-bridge and ~/.local/share/agent-assets/omp/omp.previous), so this is not reachable today; naming the callers' parents in the case (129-135) would keep a later caller from passing a seat-writable destination.

The proof precedes the write by one command for CompactionDB (2836-2837) and the omp aside (1511), but for the pi bridge it precedes the unpack, the patches, bun install and the gap check before the rm -rf and mv of 1669-1678, and for the security-audit skill the unpack before 1736-1745; a parent replaced by a link inside that window is written through. ~/.agents and ~/.local/lib are no seat write root, so only an uncontained process could race it; repeating the proof just before the rename would shorten the window to one command at every site.

mkdir -p of the parent runs before the proof (1511, 1647, 1727, 2835): through a linked component it creates empty directories outside the asset tree before the refusal. Only directories are created, nothing is deleted.
